title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the magnetic induction, B = (√3 mv) / (2qa).

title: Time in magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the time of motion in the magnetic field, t = (4√3 π a) / (9v).

title: Coordinates at zero velocity
description: Essential: Correctly states the final coordinates when velocity first becomes zero in the electric field, (-mv²/(2qE), √3 a).

title: Geometry for circular path
description: Important: Correctly relates the launch point and angle to the radius of the circular motion, e.g., using r = a / cos 30°.

title: Force balance in magnetic field
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law with the Lorentz force to establish qvB = mv²/r.

title: Angle and time fraction
description: Important: Correctly identifies the central angle of the circular arc (e.g., 120° or 2π/3 rad) and relates it to the fraction of the period.

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: Applies constant-acceleration kinematics or work-energy theorem to find the distance traveled in the electric field before stopping.

title: Sign error in coordinate
description: Pitfall: Places the zero-velocity x-coordinate in the first quadrant (positive) instead of the correct second quadrant (negative).

title: Unit or vector omission
description: Pitfall: Provides a scalar answer for the coordinates or omits units in final expressions without justification.
